description: Blazor.AI core runtime: multi-provider IChatClient factory (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, DeepSeek, Grok, Ollama, LocalGen, llama.cpp, Hugging Face), offline simulated provider, SIMD in-memory vector index, Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData adapter, smart-component service…

Blazor.AI retrieval-augmented generation: document ingestion (PDF, text, markdown, CSV, Excel), chunking, vector search, PDF and spreadsheet chat, citations, knowledge explorer and knowledge-graph extraction.

Blazor.AI decision intelligence: rules engine, DMN-style decision tables, decision trees, business policies, risk assessment, eligibility, approval workflows and dynamic pricing, with TypeSafe System One integration.
Blazor.AI visual analytics: AI dashboards, realtime, prediction and forecast charts, network graph, heatmap, Sankey, treemap, geo analytics map and knowledge graph. Pure SVG, powered by Visual.Net.

Blazor.AI biology analysis components powered by Biotech.Net: DNA sequence analysis, restriction maps, pairwise and multiple alignment with phylogenetic trees, protein analysis, molecule and ADMET explorer, CRISPR guide design, primer design, codon optimisation, differential expression and an AI bi…
Blazor.AI machine learning, data science and reinforcement learning workbenches powered by Gravicode.Science (GraviLearn, GraviFrame, GraviProb) and Gravicode.RLNet.
Blazor.AI contracts: provider options, vector index, smart-component contracts, security (PII, moderation, audit, RBAC) and prompt storage abstractions. Built on Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Abstractions.

Blazor.AI Razor components: Smart Components (SmartPaste, SmartTextArea, SmartComboBox, SmartSemanticSearch, SmartSummarizer, SmartTranslator, SmartClassifier, SmartEmailComposer, SmartRecommendations), Copilot-style chat, prompt tooling, content and coding assistants with a Bootstrap 5 glassmorphi…
Blazor.AI agents: agent studio, tool calling, task board, memory viewer, debugger, MCP server explorer, visual workflow designer and multi-agent orchestration.

dotnet new templates for Blazor.AI: a Blazor Web App wired with AI providers, chat, SmartPaste and the kawung theme. Install with: dotnet new install Blazor.AI.Templates, then: dotnet new blazorai -n MyApp.

Blazor.AI Hugging Face and local models: model hub browser, downloader, inference playground, embeddings, classification, sentiment, NER, image classification, OCR, speech; local inference via HF.Net GraviTransformers and ONNX Runtime.
